summary: Reports > Timesheet Activities: Staff filter has unwanted auto-selection and dependency issues
reported_issue: Multiple filter issues in Timesheet Activities: (A) selecting a staff with no data alongside a date filter auto-selects a different staff who has data instead of showing empty; (B) selecting certain date filters with no staff selected auto-selects a staff member.
expected_after_fix: If a selected staff has no data for the chosen date range, the table should show an empty state and not auto-select a different staff. No staff should be auto-selected when changing the date filter without an explicit staff selection.
steps_i_followed: Logged in as admin, opened Reports > Timesheet Activities (/reports/punch-clock-activities). Confirmed default 'This Month' shows data for all staff with an empty 'Filter By Staff'.
Issue A: Selected staff 'Tech ShopView' (who has data for 'This Month' - rows Jul 01 and Jul 03 2026 - but no punch data for yesterday Jul 04).
Changed the date filter from 'This Month' to 'Yesterday'.
Read back the 'Filter By Staff' input value, the date label, and the results table.
Issue B (from prior run, fresh-cookie confirmation): with no staff selected, changed date filter and confirmed the staff control stayed empty.
actual_now: Issue A does NOT reproduce. After selecting 'Tech ShopView' and switching the date filter to 'Yesterday' (a range with no data for that staff), the 'Filter By Staff' control still showed 'Tech ShopView' (it did NOT auto-swap to a different staff who has data), and the results table showed an empty state (0 rows, empty-state hint present). This matches expected_after_fix. Issue B was previously verified: selecting a date filter with no staff selected does not auto-select any staff. Both issues behave correctly on current staging.
notes: Re-run with fresh cookies completes Issue A (previously blocked by session expiry). Issue A: no auto-selection, empty state shown. Issue B: no auto-selection on date change without explicit staff. Both fixed.
